title: Bash Command Checker Configuration
description: Reload Pi after changing this file. Invalid configuration disables the checker, not the permission system.

$schema.description: Optional schema location for editor validation.

model.description: Null selects the current session model at request time. Explicit models do not fall back.

language.description: LLM explanation language: en for English, zh for Simplified Chinese. Does not affect classification or UI labels.

model.description: Null disables classification. No automatic provider fallback is used.

timeoutMs.description: Total classification deadline, including model availability checks, in milliseconds.

safe.description: Minimum probability for safe-ro or safe-rw, also requiring the confidence threshold.

unsafe.description: Minimum unsafe probability, also requiring the confidence threshold. Unsafe takes priority.

confidence.description: Minimum confidence required to accept any of the three classifier labels.

commandViewerShortcut.description: Open the full command in an external editor when the widget is visible. At least one modifier (ctrl, alt, shift or super) is required; unmodified keys are not accepted. Escape/esc, clear and function keys (f1-f12) cannot be configured, even with modifiers; no viewer close keys are registered. Use shift+= rather than + as a base key. Reload Pi to apply changes. Alt+c requires a terminal that reports the combination distinctly.

command.description: Executable name or path, resolved through PATH when applicable. Never parsed as a shell command. Null leaves the viewer unconfigured. Windows .cmd launchers require an actual executable instead.

args.description: Literal arguments. The absolute command-file path is appended as the last argument. No shell expansion.

mode.description: Detach starts without terminal access or waiting. Wait suspends the Pi TUI and main event loop until the editor exits.

filePath.description: Directory for session command files. Accepts POSIX or Windows absolute-path syntax; it must also be absolute on the running system when opened. Null uses pi-permission-bash-cmd-checker under the system temporary directory. Files use command-<sessionId>.sh, are overwritten per session, and are not automatically deleted.

autoBlockUnsafe.description: Deny only validated unsafe classifications. All other outcomes defer; never automatically allow.
